title: State Management (Redux-like)
description: Build a Redux-like state management library with reducers, middleware, selectors, and time-travel debugging.

steps.title: Create Store class
steps.description: Build a Store class with `getState()`, `dispatch(action)`, and `subscribe(listener)`. The store is initialized with a reducer and initial state. Dispatching an action runs the reducer and notifies all listeners. Print the initial state to console.
hints: Store holds currentState, reducer function, and a Set of listeners
dispatch() calls reducer(currentState, action) and replaces state immutably
subscribe() returns an unsubscribe function that removes the listener from the Set

verification.successMessage: Store initializes and prints the initial state correctly
verification.failureMessage: Store did not create or display initial state properly

steps.title: Implement reducers and actions
steps.description: Create pure reducer functions that handle typed actions with a switch statement or equivalent pattern. Actions have a `type` field and optional payload. Implement a counter reducer with INCREMENT, DECREMENT, and RESET actions. Print each state transition.
hints: Reducer is a pure function: (state, action) => state
Always return a new object, never mutate state directly
Use a switch on action.type with a default case that returns state unchanged

verification.successMessage: Reducer handles actions and state transitions correctly
verification.failureMessage: Reducer did not produce expected state after dispatching actions

steps.title: Add middleware chain
steps.description: Implement `applyMiddleware(...middlewares)` that wraps dispatch with a chain of middleware functions. Each middleware has the signature `(store) => (next) => (action)`. Create logging middleware and async middleware. Print the middleware execution order.
hints: applyMiddleware composes middlewares: middleware1(middleware2(store.dispatch))
Logging middleware prints action type, prev state, next state
Async middleware checks if action is a function, calls it with dispatch if so

verification.successMessage: Middleware chain executes in the correct order
verification.failureMessage: Middleware did not execute or order was incorrect

steps.title: Implement selectors with memoization
steps.description: Create `createSelector(...inputSelectors, resultFn)` that computes derived data and caches results. The selector only recomputes when its input selectors return new values. Print both cached and recomputed results to demonstrate memoization.
hints: Store previous arguments and previous result; compare with === (reference check)
createSelector returns a function that checks if inputs changed before recomputing
Use .length of selectors to determine how many arguments to compare

verification.successMessage: Memoized selector caches results and recomputes only when inputs change
verification.failureMessage: Selector did not cache or recompute correctly

steps.title: Add combineReducers
steps.description: Build `combineReducers(reducers)` that takes an object of slice reducers and returns a single reducer. Each slice reducer manages its own portion of the state tree. Dispatch an action and verify only the relevant slice updates. Print the full state tree.
hints: combineReducers returns a function that iterates over each slice reducer
Each call is reducer(state[key], action) and builds a new state object
Throw an error if a reducer returns undefined as a safety check

verification.successMessage: combineReducers correctly splits state into slices
verification.failureMessage: Combined reducers did not produce the expected state tree

steps.title: Implement time-travel debugging
steps.description: Save the history of dispatched actions and corresponding states. Implement `undo()` and `redo()` methods that move through history. The current state is the state at the current history pointer. Print the state at each step as the user moves forward and backward.
hints: Store a past array and a future array instead of a flat history
On dispatch, push current state to past, clear future, compute new state
undo() pops from past, pushes current to future; redo() reverses this

verification.successMessage: Time-travel debugging correctly jumps between past and future states
verification.failureMessage: Undo/redo did not restore the expected previous state

steps.title: Build a devtools logger
steps.description: Build a devtools logger that formats each action with the previous state, action type, payload, and next state in a readable colored or structured log. Group related log entries and support collapse. Print a sample formatted log entry.
hints: Format %c styled console output with CSS strings for colors
Log action type as a styled group header, then prev state, then next state
Use console.groupCollapsed() to group and collapse related entries

verification.successMessage: Devtools logger formats action, prev state, and next state correctly
verification.failureMessage: Logger did not produce a properly formatted devtools entry
